scope: Mounted danger to reactive static-mortar finite mission, not whole mounted-source parity

source.intent: Effective commander uses native believed hostile position for an artillery/static response. Source may issue autonomous mortar rounds and delayed repeats. CBE uses one finite existing server/owner fire mission, with no blind repeated rounds.

finding: CBE sender supplied untimestamped raw danger geometry; server compared it against getPosATL of hidden enemy and queued mission lacked a short original danger-fix lifetime.
implementation: Current owner validates original identity/witness expiry and current native belief, then reports that believed geometry with serverTime. No new enemy knowledge.
Authenticated server admission requires finite original observation no older than10s and no more than1s future tolerance; no real enemy transform comparison.

Fixed dangerUntil=observedAt+10 is stored once, checked by server mission and passed unchanged in shot signature. Existing owner session gate checks it before safety and atomic native fire. No renewed expiry or new worker.
Support/counter fire retain existing semantics; shot payload appends expiry without dropping any prior serial/generation field.
An expired already-issued shot remains uncertain; expiry is not proof the engine cancelled it.
